mechanism_claims.claim_text: This paper provides indirect genetic-transfer evidence that determinants for streptococcin A-FF22 production and producer-cell immunity can be transduced among group A streptococci; it does not perform direct molecular mode-of-action assays for the bacteriocin.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: streptococcin A-FF22 production/immunity determinants in group A streptococci
mechanism_claims.limitations: APD6 MOA statements about DNA/RNA/protein synthesis and later sequence/modification annotations are not promoted as direct mechanism evidence from this 1976 paper.

mechanism_summary: No direct antimicrobial molecular mechanism is asserted from this paper. Mechanism layer is limited to source-supported genetic determinant transfer/immunity context.
